items.question: How should the guru be worshipped after offering bali with the sixteen-syllable mantra?
premises: Bali is offered with sixteen-syllable mantra.
Guru is worshipped by mātṛkā etc.
Worship uses that name and namonta.
items.inference: Worship proceeds through mātṛkā, that name, and namonta.
uncertainties: Exact referent of mātṛkādyena is not explicit.
items.plain_english: One should worship with mātṛkā and so on, by that name, with namonta.
